pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anācāraṃ ācaritvā ekamekassa kamme kariyamāne paṭikkosanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.3: tena kho pana samayena saṃgho sannipatito hoti kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.4: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karontā ekassa chandaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.6: ayaṃ āvuso chabbaggiyo bhikkhu ekako āgato, hand' assa mayaṃ kammaṃ karomā 'ti tassa kammaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.7: atha kho so bhikkhu yena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.8: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.11: na mayaṃ āvuso etadatthāya chandaṃ adamhā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.13: sace ca mayaṃ jāneyyāma tuyhaṃ kammaṃ karissatīti na mayaṃ chandaṃ dadeyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyadhammaṃ āpajjissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.16: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyadhammaṃ āpajjathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā dhammikānaṃ . . . āpajjissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.20: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.21: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:1.22.1: yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.1.6: apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakammaṃ dhammena vinayena satthu sāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī chandaṃ datvā khīyati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc79:2.3.2: adhammena vā vaggena vā na kammārahassa vā kammaṃ katan ti jānanto khīyati,
